categories.hint: Total of both ages' Intermediate Scoring (temples, pyramids, fewest-pyramids province, Nile majorities, yellow Favor cards); add before the Gold ranking.

categories.label: Gold cards ranking bonus
categories.hint: Reveal Gold cards: highest combined value +6, 2nd +4, 3rd +2. Ties: all get the full points, next rank is pushed down.

notes: family: auction-money. Intermediate Scoring happens at the end of each of the 2 ages (VP tracked on the board track), so the scorer enters the final track VP. Verified only against a secondary rules summary; the 20th Anniversary rulebook may differ in details (not retrievable).
